<summary><span>Theorem 13.1</span><span class="result-count">5 endpoints</span></summary>
<div class="result-body">

<summary><span>Theorem 13.2</span><span class="result-count">4 endpoints</span></summary>
<div class="result-body">
<div class="textbook-statement"><p>If $W=(Z'Z)^{-1}$, then $\hat\beta_{\mathrm{GMM}}=\hat\beta_{\mathrm{2SLS}}$; if $k=\ell$, then $\hat\beta_{\mathrm{GMM}}=\hat\beta_{\mathrm{IV}}$.</p></div>

<details class="result-group" id="theorem-13-3">
<summary><span>Theorem 13.3</span><span class="result-count">5 endpoints</span></summary>
<div class="result-body">
<div class="textbook-statement"><p>If $\hat W\xrightarrow{p}W\succ0$, then $\sqrt n(\hat\beta_{\mathrm{GMM}}-\beta)\xrightarrow{d}N(0,V_\beta)$ with $V_\beta=(Q'WQ)^{-1}(Q'W\Omega WQ)(Q'WQ)^{-1}$.</p></div>

<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-gmmlinearizedscore-tendstoindistribution">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.gmmLinearizedScore_tendstoInDistribution</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>The random GMM influence matrix applied to the scaled instrument score has
the sandwich Gaussian limit in Hansen equation (13.7). </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {OmegaSpace : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace OmegaSpace] {mu : MeasureTheory.Measure OmegaSpace}
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu] {k : Type u_2} {l : Type u_3} [inst_2 : Fintype k]
  [inst_3 : Fintype l] [inst_4 : DecidableEq k] [inst_5 : DecidableEq l] {Qhat : Nat → OmegaSpace → Matrix l k Real}
  {What : Nat → OmegaSpace → Matrix l l Real} {Z : Nat → OmegaSpace → l → Real} {e : Nat → OmegaSpace → Real}
  {Q : Matrix l k Real} {W : Matrix l l Real},
  HansenEconometrics.GMMMomentCLTConditions mu Qhat What Z e Q W →
    MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
      (fun n omega =&gt;
        (HansenEconometrics.gmmLinearizationMatrixStar (Qhat n omega) (What n omega)).mulVec
          (instHSMul.hSMul n.cast.sqrt
            (HansenEconometrics.sampleCrossMoment (HansenEconometrics.stackRegressors Z n omega)
              (HansenEconometrics.stackErrors e n omega))))
      Filter.atTop (fun z =&gt; z.ofLp) (fun x =&gt; mu)
      (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0
        (HansenEconometrics.gmmAsymptoticVarianceStar Q W (HansenEconometrics.scoreCovMat mu Z e)))</code></pre>
</details>

<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-gmmbetastar-tendstoindistribution">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.gmmBetaStar_tendstoInDistribution</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p><strong>Hansen Theorem 13.3 (Star form).</strong> Under convergence of the sample
derivative and weight matrix, the linear GMM estimator is asymptotically
normal with the sandwich covariance in equation (13.8). </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {OmegaSpace : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace OmegaSpace] {mu : MeasureTheory.Measure OmegaSpace}
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu] {k : Type u_2} {l : Type u_3} [inst_2 : Fintype k]
  [inst_3 : Fintype l] [inst_4 : DecidableEq k] [inst_5 : DecidableEq l] {What : Nat → OmegaSpace → Matrix l l Real}
  {Z : Nat → OmegaSpace → l → Real} {X : Nat → OmegaSpace → k → Real} {e Y : Nat → OmegaSpace → Real}
  {Q : Matrix l k Real} {W : Matrix l l Real},
  HansenEconometrics.GMMMomentCLTConditions mu
      (fun n omega =&gt;
        HansenEconometrics.sampleQZX (HansenEconometrics.stackRegressors Z n omega)
          (HansenEconometrics.stackRegressors X n omega))
      What Z e Q W →
    ∀ (b : k → Real),
      (∀ (i : Nat) (omega : OmegaSpace), Eq (Y i omega) (instHAdd.hAdd (dotProduct (X i omega) b) (e i omega))) →
        (∀ (n : Nat),
            AEMeasurable
              (fun omega =&gt;
                instHSMul.hSMul n.cast.sqrt
                  (instHSub.hSub
                    (HansenEconometrics.gmmBetaStar (HansenEconometrics.stackRegressors X n omega)
                      (HansenEconometrics.stackRegressors Z n omega) (HansenEconometrics.stackOutcomes Y n omega)
                      (What n omega))
                    b))
              mu) →
          MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
            (fun n omega =&gt;
              instHSMul.hSMul n.cast.sqrt
                (instHSub.hSub
                  (HansenEconometrics.gmmBetaStar (HansenEconometrics.stackRegressors X n omega)
                    (HansenEconometrics.stackRegressors Z n omega) (HansenEconometrics.stackOutcomes Y n omega)
                    (What n omega))
                  b))
            Filter.atTop (fun z =&gt; z.ofLp) (fun x =&gt; mu)
            (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0

<details class="result-group" id="proposition-13-1">
<summary><span>Proposition 13.1</span><span class="result-count">2 endpoints</span></summary>
<div class="result-body">
<div class="textbook-statement"><p>A nonlinear GMM estimator satisfies $\sqrt n(\hat\beta-\beta)\xrightarrow{d}N(0,V)$ with sandwich covariance; efficient weighting gives $V=(Q'\Omega^{-1}Q)^{-1}$.</p></div>
<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-nonlineargmmbeta-tendstoindistribution">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.nonlinearGMMBeta_tendstoInDistribution</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p><strong>Hansen Proposition 13.1.</strong> A nonlinear GMM estimator with the standard
first-order expansion has the sandwich Gaussian limit.</p>
<p>Here <code>Q</code> is the derivative of the population moment. Therefore, the
linearization uses the negative GMM influence matrix. Its sign cancels from
the covariance. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {OmegaSpace : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace OmegaSpace] {mu : MeasureTheory.Measure OmegaSpace}
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu] {k : Type u_2} {l : Type u_3} [inst_2 : Fintype k]
  [inst_3 : Fintype l] [inst_4 : DecidableEq k] [inst_5 : DecidableEq l] (bhat : Nat → OmegaSpace → k → Real)
  (b : k → Real) (score : Nat → OmegaSpace → l → Real) (Q : Matrix l k Real) (W Omega : Matrix l l Real),
  Omega.PosSemidef →
    MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution score Filter.atTop (fun z =&gt; z.ofLp) (fun x =&gt; mu)
        (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 Omega) →
      (∀ (n : Nat),
          AEMeasurable (fun omega =&gt; { ofLp := instHSMul.hSMul n.cast.sqrt (instHSub.hSub (bhat n omega) b) }) mu) →
        (MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure mu
            (fun n omega =&gt;
              instHSub.hSub { ofLp := instHSMul.hSMul n.cast.sqrt (instHSub.hSub (bhat n omega) b) }
                (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                  (HansenEconometrics.matrixContinuousLinearMap
                    (Matrix.neg.neg (HansenEconometrics.LinearGMM.influenceMatrixStar Q W)))
                  { ofLp := score n omega }))
            Filter.atTop fun x =&gt; 0) →
          MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
            (fun n omega =&gt; instHSMul.hSMul n.cast.sqrt (instHSub.hSub (bhat n omega) b)) Filter.atTop (fun z =&gt; z.ofLp)
            (fun x =&gt; mu)
            (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (HansenEconometrics.gmmAsymptoticVarianceStar Q W Omega))</code></pre>
</details>
<details class="dependency-list"><summary>Direct statement dependencies (3)</summary><ul><li><code>HansenEconometrics.LinearGMM.influenceMatrixStar</code></li><li><code>HansenEconometrics.gmmAsymptoticVarianceStar</code></li><li><code>HansenEconometrics.matrixContinuousLinearMap</code></li></ul></details>
<p class="declaration-meta"><a href="https://github.com/apoorvalal/lean-hansen-econometrics/blob/main/HansenEconometrics/Chapter13GMM/Nonlinear.lean#L31">HansenEconometrics/Chapter13GMM/Nonlinear.lean:31</a></p>
</div>
</details>
<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-nonlineargmmbeta-tendstoindistribution-efficient">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.nonlinearGMMBeta_tendstoInDistribution_efficient</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Efficient-weight form of Hansen Proposition 13.1. With a positive-definite
moment covariance and a full-rank derivative, the sandwich covariance reduces
to <code>(Q' Omega⁻¹ Q)⁻¹</code>. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {OmegaSpace : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace OmegaSpace] {mu : MeasureTheory.Measure OmegaSpace}
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu] {k : Type u_2} {l : Type u_3} [inst_2 : Fintype k]
  [inst_3 : Fintype l] [inst_4 : DecidableEq k] [inst_5 : DecidableEq l] (bhat : Nat → OmegaSpace → k → Real)
  (b : k → Real) (score : Nat → OmegaSpace → l → Real) (Q : Matrix l k Real) (Omega : Matrix l l Real),
  Omega.PosDef →
    Function.Injective Q.mulVec →
      MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution score Filter.atTop (fun z =&gt; z.ofLp) (fun x =&gt; mu)
          (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 Omega) →
        (∀ (n : Nat),
            AEMeasurable (fun omega =&gt; { ofLp := instHSMul.hSMul n.cast.sqrt (instHSub.hSub (bhat n omega) b) }) mu) →
          (MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure mu
              (fun n omega =&gt;
                instHSub.hSub { ofLp := instHSMul.hSMul n.cast.sqrt (instHSub.hSub (bhat n omega) b) }
                  (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                    (HansenEconometrics.matrixContinuousLinearMap
                      (Matrix.neg.neg (HansenEconometrics.LinearGMM.influenceMatrixStar Q (Matrix.inv.inv Omega))))
                    { ofLp := score n omega }))
              Filter.atTop fun x =&gt; 0) →
            MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
              (fun n omega =&gt; instHSMul.hSMul n.cast.sqrt (instHSub.hSub (bhat n omega) b)) Filter.atTop
              (fun z =&gt; z.ofLp) (fun x =&gt; mu)
              (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0
                (Matrix.inv.inv (HansenEconometrics.gmmPopulationGram Q (Matrix.inv.inv Omega))))</code></pre>
</details>
